name: process_manager
description: List, monitor, and manage system processes. Find running processes, check resource usage, and kill processes.

manual.overview: Use to inspect running processes, find resource hogs, or terminate stuck processes when debugging hangs or memory issues.

examples.description: List top 10 processes by CPU usage
Find all processes matching 'node' by name
Terminate a specific process by PID

tips: Use find before kill to confirm you have the right process
Check top when diagnosing slowness or high memory usage
Prefer graceful shutdown (e.g., SIGTERM) over force-kill when possible
edge_cases: Killing system or IDE processes can cause data loss or crashes
PIDs recycle; verify process identity before killing

executor.command: python -c "import psutil, json; action='{{args.action}}'; procs=[{'pid':p.info['pid'],'name':p.info['name'],'cpu':p.info.get('cpu_percent',0),'memory_mb':round((p.info.get('memory_info') and p.info['memory_info'].rss or 0)/1048576,1)} for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','name','cpu_percent','memory_info'])]; procs.sort(key=lambda x:-x['cpu']); print(json.dumps(procs[:{{args.limit}}], indent=2))"
